mapper.select:
SELECT /* getCurrentUserList */ P.USER_NUMB , P.USER_NICK , P.USER_PROV , P.USER_PROV_NAME , P.USER_ROLE , P.USER_STAT , P.USER_STAT_NAME , P.ONBD_YSNO , P.ONBD_YSNO_NAME , P.JOIN_DATE , P.WTHD_DATE , P.DELT_DATE , P.LAST_LOGN_DATE , P.REPORT_CNTT FROM ( SELECT R.USER_NUMB , R.USER_NICK , R.USER_PROV , R.USER_PROV_NAME , R.USER_ROLE , R.USER_STAT , R.USER_STAT_NAME , R.ONBD_YSNO , R.ONBD_YSNO_NAME , R.JOIN_DATE , R.WTHD_DATE , R.DELT_DATE , R.LAST_LOGN_DATE , R.REPORT_CNTT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY R.JOIN_DATE DESC , R.USER_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN ( SELECT H.USER_NUMB , MAX(H.LOGN_DATE) AS LAST_LOGN_DATE FROM TB_LOGHIS H WHERE H.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY H.USER_NUMB ) L ON L.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS REPORT_CNTT FROM TM_REPORT T GROUP BY T.USER_NUMB ) R ON R.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY U.JOIN_DATE DESC , U.USER_NUMB DESC ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getCurrentUserListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getCurrentUserDtl */ U.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_PROV , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{userProvCode}, U.USER_PROV, NULL) AS USER_PROV_NAME , U.USER_ROLE , U.USER_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{userStatCode}, U.USER_STAT, #{userStatCode}) AS USER_STAT_NAME , COALESCE(E.SYNC_STAT, #{userStatusSyncCompleted}) AS USER_STATUS_SYNC_STAT , U.ONBD_YSNO , CASE U.ONBD_YSNO WHEN #{yes} THEN '완료' ELSE '미완료' END AS ONBD_YSNO_NAME , U.INTR_CNTN , PF.FILE_PATH AS PROF_PATH , BF.FILE_PATH AS BGIM_PATH , U.JOIN_DATE , U.WTHD_DATE , U.DELT_DATE , L.LAST_LOGN_DATE , COALESCE(R.REPORT_CNTT, 0) AS REPORT_CNTT , COALESCE(P.REPLY_CNTT, 0) AS REPLY_CNTT , COALESCE(K.LIKE_CNTT, 0) AS LIKE_CNTT , COALESCE(F.FOLLOWING_CNTT, 0) AS FOLLOWING_CNTT , COALESCE(W.FOLLOWER_CNTT, 0) AS FOLLOWER_CNTT , COALESCE(G.GOAL_CNTT, 0) AS GOAL_CNTT , COALESCE(S.PUSH_CNTT, 0) AS PUSH_CNTT FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM PF ON PF.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM BF ON BF.FILE_NUMB = U.BGIM_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT H.USER_NUMB , MAX(H.LOGN_DATE) AS LAST_LOGN_DATE FROM TB_LOGHIS H WHERE H.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY H.USER_NUMB ) L ON L.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS REPORT_CNTT FROM TM_REPORT T WHERE T.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY T.USER_NUMB ) R ON R.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS REPLY_CNTT FROM TB_REPLXX P WHERE P.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY P.USER_NUMB ) P ON P.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT K.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS LIKE_CNTT FROM TB_LIKEXX K WHERE K.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY K.USER_NUMB ) K ON K.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT F.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS FOLLOWING_CNTT FROM TB_FOLLOW F WHERE F.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY F.USER_NUMB ) F ON F.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT W.FLOW_NUMB AS USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS FOLLOWER_CNTT FROM TB_FOLLOW W WHERE W.FLOW_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY W.FLOW_NUMB ) W ON W.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT G.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS GOAL_CNTT FROM TM_GOALXM G WHERE G.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY G.USER_NUMB ) G ON G.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.USER_NUMB , COUNT(1) AS PUSH_CNTT FROM TB_PSHSUB S WHERE S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(S.USEE_YSNO, #{yes}) = #{yes} GROUP BY S.USER_NUMB ) S ON S.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT E.USER_NUMB , E.SYNC_STAT FROM TH_USSPND E WHERE E.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY E.SPND_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1 ) E ON E.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getCurrentUserCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getLoginHistoryList */ P.LOGN_NUMB , P.LOGN_DATE , P.LOGN_IPXX , P.USER_AGNT , P.PROV_CODE , P.PROV_CODE_NAME FROM ( SELECT R.LOGN_NUMB , R.LOGN_DATE , R.LOGN_IPXX , R.USER_AGNT , R.PROV_CODE , R.PROV_CODE_NAME , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY R.LOGN_DATE DESC , R.LOGN_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT H.LOGN_NUMB , H.LOGN_DATE , CASE WHEN H.LOGN_IPXX IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LOCATE('.', H.LOGN_IPXX) > 0 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(H.LOGN_IPXX, '.', 2), '.***.***') ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTR(H.LOGN_IPXX, 1, 4), ':****') END AS LOGN_IPXX , H.USER_AGNT , H.PROV_CODE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME( #{userProvCode}, H.PROV_CODE, NULL ) AS PROV_CODE_NAME FROM TB_LOGHIS H WHERE H.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY H.LOGN_DATE DESC , H.LOGN_NUMB DESC ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getLoginHistoryListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TB_LOGHIS WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getWithdrawalHistoryList */ P.WTHD_NUMB , P.WTHD_TYPE , P.WTHD_TYPE_NAME , P.WTHD_RSON , P.WTHD_RSON_NAME , P.WTHD_STAT , P.WTHD_STAT_NAME , P.REQU_DATE , P.DELT_DATE , P.PROC_DATE , P.RCOV_DATE FROM ( SELECT R.WTHD_NUMB , R.WTHD_TYPE , R.WTHD_TYPE_NAME , R.WTHD_RSON , R.WTHD_RSON_NAME , R.WTHD_STAT , R.WTHD_STAT_NAME , R.REQU_DATE , R.DELT_DATE , R.PROC_DATE , R.RCOV_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY R.REQU_DATE DESC , R.WTHD_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT W.WTHD_NUMB , W.WTHD_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{wthdType}, W.WTHD_TYPE, #{wthdType}) AS WTHD_TYPE_NAME , W.WTHD_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{wthdRson}, W.WTHD_RSON, #{wthdRson}) AS WTHD_RSON_NAME , W.WTHD_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{wthdStat}, W.WTHD_STAT, #{wthdStat}) AS WTHD_STAT_NAME , W.REQU_DATE , W.DELT_DATE , W.PROC_DATE , W.RCOV_DATE FROM TH_USWTHD W WHERE W.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY W.REQU_DATE DESC , W.WTHD_NUMB DESC ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getWithdrawalHistoryCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_USWTHD WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getComplaintHistoryList */ P.CMPL_NUMB , P.REPORTER_USER_NUMB , P.REPORTER_NICK , P.TAGT_TYPE , P.TAGT_TYPE_NAME , P.TAGT_NUMB , P.TAGT_CNTN , P.CMPL_RSON , P.CMPL_RSON_NAME , P.CMPL_CNTN , P.CMPL_STAT , P.CMPL_STAT_NAME , P.PROC_ADMN_NAME , P.PROC_DATE , P.REGI_DATE FROM ( SELECT C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB AS REPORTER_USER_NUMB , R.USER_NICK AS REPORTER_NICK , C.TAGT_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplTagt}, C.TAGT_TYPE, #{cmplTagt}) AS TAGT_TYPE_NAME , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.TAGT_CNTN , C.CMPL_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRson}, C.CMPL_RSON, #{cmplRson}) AS CMPL_RSON_NAME , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplStat}, C.CMPL_STAT, #{cmplStat}) AS CMPL_STAT_NAME , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.PROC_ADMN) AS PROC_ADMN_NAME , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY C.REGI_DATE DESC , C.CMPL_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB WHERE C.TAGT_USER = #{userNumb} ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getComplaintHistoryCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_CMPLNT WHERE TAGT_USER = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getUserStatusForUpdate */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getActiveSuspForUpdate */ SPND_NUMB , USER_NUMB , PREV_STAT , SPND_TYPE , SPND_RSON , SPND_CNTN , SPND_STAT , SYNC_STAT , STRT_DATE , ENDX_DATE , RLES_DATE , RLES_CNTN , REGI_ADMN , RLES_ADMN , REGI_DATE , UPDT_ADMN , UPDT_DATE FROM TH_USSPND WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptUserSuspensionExpired */ TH_USSPND SET SPND_STAT = 'EXPIRED' , RLES_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UPDT_ADMN = #{updtAdmn,jdbcType=NUMERIC} , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SPND_NUMB = #{spndNumb} AND SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND SPND_TYPE = 'PERIOD' AND ENDX_DATE <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE /* uptCurrentUserSuspended */ TM_USERXM SET USER_STAT = 'SUSPENDED' WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND USER_STAT IN ('ACTIVE', 'WITHDRAWN')
mapper.select: SELECT /* getSuspensionHistoryList */ P.SPND_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.PREV_STAT , P.SPND_TYPE , P.SPND_TYPE_NAME , P.SPND_RSON , P.SPND_RSON_NAME , P.SPND_CNTN , P.SPND_STAT , P.SPND_STAT_NAME , P.SYNC_STAT , P.STRT_DATE , P.ENDX_DATE , P.RLES_DATE , P.RLES_CNTN , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.RLES_ADMN , P.RLES_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_ADMN , P.UPDT_DATE FROM ( SELECT R.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY R.STRT_DATE DESC , R.SPND_NUMB DESC ) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT S.SPND_NUMB , S.USER_NUMB , S.PREV_STAT , S.SPND_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndType}, S.SPND_TYPE, #{spndType}) AS SPND_TYPE_NAME , S.SPND_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndRson}, S.SPND_RSON, #{spndRson}) AS SPND_RSON_NAME , S.SPND_CNTN , S.SPND_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndStat}, S.SPND_STAT, #{spndStat}) AS SPND_STAT_NAME , S.SYNC_STAT , S.STRT_DATE , S.ENDX_DATE , S.RLES_DATE , S.RLES_CNTN , S.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , S.RLES_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.RLES_ADMN) AS RLES_ADMN_NAME , S.REGI_DATE , S.UPDT_ADMN , S.UPDT_DATE FROM TH_USSPND S WHERE S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY S.STRT_DATE DESC , S.SPND_NUMB DESC ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT /* getSuspensionHistoryCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_USSPND WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getDeletedSuspensionList */ P.SPND_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.PREV_STAT , P.SPND_TYPE , P.SPND_TYPE_NAME , P.SPND_RSON , P.SPND_RSON_NAME , P.SPND_CNTN , P.SPND_STAT , P.SPND_STAT_NAME , P.STRT_DATE , P.ENDX_DATE , P.REGI_ADMN , P.REGI_ADMN_NAME , P.REGI_DATE FROM ( SELECT R.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.STRT_DATE DESC, R.SPND_NUMB DESC) AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT S.SPND_NUMB , S.USER_NUMB , S.PREV_STAT , S.SPND_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndType}, S.SPND_TYPE, #{spndType}) AS SPND_TYPE_NAME , S.SPND_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndRson}, S.SPND_RSON, #{spndRson}) AS SPND_RSON_NAME , S.SPND_CNTN , S.SPND_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndStat}, S.SPND_STAT, #{spndStat}) AS SPND_STAT_NAME , S.STRT_DATE , S.ENDX_DATE , S.REGI_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(S.REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME , S.REGI_DATE FROM TH_USSPND S LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = S.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB IS NULL AND S.SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.SPND_TYPE = 'INDEFINITE' OR S.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (#{userNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) ) R ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB

SELECT /* getDeletedSuspensionCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_USSPND S LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = S.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB IS NULL AND S.SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.SPND_TYPE = 'INDEFINITE' OR S.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (#{userNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb,jdbcType=NUMERIC})

SELECT /* getDeletedActiveSuspForUpdate */ S.SPND_NUMB , S.USER_NUMB , S.SPND_TYPE , S.ENDX_DATE , S.SPND_STAT FROM TH_USSPND S LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = S.USER_NUMB WHERE S.SPND_NUMB = #{spndNumb} AND S.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB IS NULL AND S.SPND_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.SPND_TYPE = 'INDEFINITE' OR S.ENDX_DATE > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FOR UPDATE
